audience: businesses that text their customers with Sakari

useCases.title: Find conversations with unread messages
useCases.text: The AI lists the inbox with contact, last message, unread count and open or closed state, and reads the messages of a conversation.

useCases.title: Check sent messages, campaigns and your balance
useCases.text: The AI lists messages with status, segments and price, the campaigns with schedule and status, and the prepaid balance.

useCases.title: Find a contact and your last messages with them
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by name, mobile or email, reads one contact with opt-in state, and lists the messages exchanged with that contact.

useCases.title: Send a text message
useCases.text: The AI sends a text to phone numbers, contacts or conversations, up to 100 recipients. Messages are real and cannot be recalled, so the AI should confirm the wording first.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact, with a rule for what to do if the mobile number already exists, or changes a contact's name, email or mobile.

useCases.title: Close a conversation or save a message template
useCases.text: The AI marks a conversation as closed in the inbox, or creates a reusable SMS template. Nothing is sent.
